issue.body_normalized:
## Description

The tab order is wrong in staatusbar for some items

## Reproduce

1. Pull https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyterlab/pull/17591
2. Tab to kernel item in status bar
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e72830d6-3ea7-40b8-b994-fb3845da3921)
3. Press Tab, see focus goes to bell icon
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a51a1dcf-8f30-4677-8025-a6aafc9c2f17)
4. Press Tab, see focus goes to lines and columns item
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d2f446af-86b7-45e9-bccc-e01cf3739ad1)


## Expected behavior

It goes to lines & columns first then to the bell icon

## Context

- JupyterLab version: 4.4.x
